Theme

Town, shops & places

brothel noun

also whorehouse, bordello, house of ill repute, bawdy house

classical

Plaut. Bacch. 3.3.50: quī in lupānārī accubat (Lewis & Short)
Quint. 7.3.6; Juv. 6.121 (Lewis & Short)

lupānar, lupānāris n.

noun, third declension

From lupa, she-wolf, a slang word for a prostitute. Traupman has no word for a brothel.

Other words

  • fornix, fornicis m. — a brothel (properly, an arch or vault)

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Hor. S. 1.2.30; Ep. 1.14.21; Juv. 3.156 (Lewis & Short)

    The cheap brothels were in vaults under buildings (Lewis & Short); hence Christian Latin fornicārī.

See also prostitute, pimp.
